name: Surry County, VA
findings: Surry County has 26 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Surry County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Surry County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
